name: trivy:scan-iac

options.description: Write report without failing when findings are detected.

summary: Scan Infrastructure as Code for security misconfigurations with Trivy.
help: Scans Infrastructure as Code in the selected project path, including Dockerfiles, Docker Compose, Kubernetes and Terraform configuration recognized by Trivy. The default path is the project root. Writes a JSON report to .docker-dev/reports/trivy-iac.json and exits with a non-zero status when Trivy finds misconfigurations at the configured severity.
